description: This Kotlin source file defines the FavoritesFragment class, an Android Fragment responsible for displaying a list of favorite recipes. It manages UI components like RecyclerView, handles user interactions such as opening recipe details and toggling favorites, and interacts with a DataRepository for data operations.

classes.name: FavoritesFragment
classes.description: Android Fragment that lists the user's favorite recipes, allowing interactions like viewing details and toggling favorites.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes the DataRepository instance when the fragment is attached to its context.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes UI components, and sets up the RecyclerView with its adapter.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Loads data whenever the fragment is resumed.

methods.name: openDetail
methods.description: Navigates to the detailed view of a selected recipe.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a recipe asynchronously.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Fetches the list of favorite recipes and updates the UI accordingly.
